Data Backup
Downloads a complete copy of all data — quotes, deliverables, materials, price list, staff and group templates — as a single JSON file on your computer. Read-only: it never changes anything in the database. Keep one before any bulk change or security work.
Data Restore
Imports a backup JSON back into the currently-connected database. This WRITES data. Always run the dry run first, and only restore against a sandbox/test database — never carelessly against live.

Design Contracts

Contract Terms
The standard terms printed on every Contract of Works. Edits apply to future contracts only — already-generated contracts keep the terms they were created with. Select text and use B / I / U / • on a clause for formatting.
Design Packages
The packages offered on design contracts — picking one when creating a contract auto-fills its description (editable per contract). Kept separate from deliverables, so these never appear in quote pickers or the Order List.

Company Signature
